metaDescription: Order custom sublimation badge id holders with full-color designs. Perfect for corporate branding. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Sublimation allows you to print vibrant, full-color graphics directly onto badge ID holders, creating a seamless look without layers or peeling. This decoration method is ideal for corporate events, trade shows, or employee IDs where you need logos, photos, or intricate patterns to stand out. The dye sublimation process bonds the ink into the fabric or coated surface, resulting in a durable, fade-resistant finish that won't crack or scratch over time. Choose sublimation for a professional, all-over print that makes your brand pop.
